name: Snowdrift
lore: An abandoned snow sculpture determined to see every season. Moves with a gentle icy glide: acceleration, gradual turns and a short coast when released.

secondary.name: Ice Chill
secondary.description: For 4 seconds, nearby enemies move 45% slower and you take 30% less damage.

special.name: Rolling Snowball
special.description: A growing snowball explodes on impact: 22–58 damage, knockback, and six small snowballs dealing 5 damage each.

technique.name: Patient Winter
technique.description: Ice Chill lasts 50% longer, but recharges 50% slower.

final_technique.name: Snowdrift Orchard
final_technique.description: Three snow blooms burst after a warning for 20 each and 2s slow. Trades the growing snowball and fragments for predictable ground coverage.

attack.name: Snowdrift Orchard
attack.description: Three snow blooms burst after a warning for 20 each and 2s slow. Trades the growing snowball and fragments for predictable ground coverage.
